M02.promptAppend: M02 judges the qualification of the assigned candidate requirement/decomposition, not application execution. Resolve genuine cross-references and assess whether its operative meaning is clear, consistent with the authoritative obligation, and verifiable at the required granularity. Preserve all applicable conditions, exceptions and prohibitions. Equivalent prose can qualify; do not require IDs, templates, unnecessary technical detail or extra splitting absent from the basis. Distinguish a concrete ambiguity, contradiction or weakened obligation in available candidate text (DEVIATION) from unavailable candidate/baseline evidence (UNVERIFIED). Do not substitute coverage of unrelated requirements, test-plan completeness or working application code for this judgement.

M03.promptAppend: M03 asks whether formal test contracts cover the entire assigned acceptance obligation. Locate actual test specifications or tests and follow genuine shared fixtures/oracles; an implementation, requirement restatement or assertion that testing passed is not a test contract. Compare the represented setup, stimulus and observable oracle against every required behavior, condition, exception and forbidden side effect. Equivalent assertions may cover multiple clauses without repeating their original IDs. A concrete omitted or weaker scenario/oracle in the available complete candidate supports DEVIATION. Missing test-contract material needed to decide supports UNVERIFIED. This is coverage of the planned checks, not proof that they were executed successfully; do not demand execution evidence for M03.

M04.promptAppend: M04 judges the assigned test contract itself. Check that required inputs/setup and stimulus are sufficiently determinate, the observation and pass/fail oracle distinguish compliant from violating behavior, and the contract remains consistent with the authoritative acceptance obligation. Follow referenced fixtures and shared checks. Reject a concrete wrong oracle, circular self-report, missing required observation, contradiction or ambiguity that prevents the intended decision. Accept equivalent prose or executable assertions without inventing a mandatory template, numeric threshold or test technique. A well-defined unexecuted test can qualify. Do not turn a missing run record into a contract defect; unavailable contract or required referenced material makes the comparison UNVERIFIED.

M06.promptAppend: M06 judges the qualification of the assigned acceptance criterion. Its conditions and observable expected outcomes must support a clear acceptance/rejection decision and preserve the authoritative obligation, including relevant exceptions, boundaries and prohibited effects. Resolve genuine references; no particular Given/When/Then syntax, ID scheme or implementation detail is required unless the basis demands it. A criterion may cover several jointly observable clauses. Identify concrete ambiguity, contradiction, weakened success/failure semantics or an unobservable circular oracle in available text as DEVIATION. Missing candidate/baseline material is UNVERIFIED. Do not confuse criterion quality with test-contract coverage, implementation correctness or actual execution closure.

M07.promptAppend: M07 checks the completeness and validity of exactly the assigned requirement-artifact relation. Read the relation and resolve each required endpoint to actual current artifact content or authoritative source anchors; matching IDs, filenames or a row marked linked alone is insufficient. Check endpoint meaning belongs to this obligation and every endpoint explicitly required by this relation is represented. Accept equivalent identifiers and genuine cross-references when the relation remains resolvable; do not invent additional artifact types or a full-project trace matrix. A wrong/dangling endpoint proven by available current content or a missing required edge in a complete relation supports DEVIATION. Inaccessible endpoint content, an incomplete snapshot or unresolved version makes the relation UNVERIFIED rather than proof of a bad artifact. A valid relation does not prove runtime behavior.

basisFiles.basis/contract.md:
# Authoritative kitchen requirement
R04: cook NAME subtracts all required quantities only when stock is sufficient, persists the result, and returns a JSON object identifying the cooked recipe. R05: an insufficient-stock failure exits nonzero, explains the failure on stderr, leaves existing store bytes unchanged, and consumes none of the available ingredients.
Qualification: the candidate requirement must state observable success and rejection behavior unambiguously and must not weaken atomic failure. No specific heading, numbering or technical implementation is prescribed.

targetFiles.project/decomposition.md:
# Preparation operations
## Prepare a saved dish
When every ingredient can satisfy its requested quantity, reduce each stock quantity by exactly that recipe amount, write the resulting inventory to the selected store, and return {"cooked": NAME} with exit 0. If any amount is unavailable, reject with a nonzero exit and an explanatory stderr; preserve the original store byte-for-byte and deduct nothing, including ingredients that were sufficient.

cases.expectedMechanism: Equivalent prose states deterministic success and atomic rejection. Missing implementation/runtime is irrelevant to requirement qualification.
